## Current authoring revision

PDF export uses native macOS Quartz to retain fractional Helvetica glyph advances. Cairo at this figure size rounded advances, producing uneven letter spacing and compressed word gaps. PNG and SVG remain generated through their existing devices.

Panel A left connects source-label group means from the available samples across five assessments: 175 at Stages 1–3, 84 at one month, and 33 eligible both-follow-up completers at 14 months. Initial-session connections are solid; both follow-up connections are dashed. “Follow-up” sits just above the first dashed segment; no vertical divider is used. Both legends use the final moderate vertical row spacing. The attrition legend matches Figure 5: both follow-ups (black triangles), one-month completers (gray triangles), and all participants (open circles), in that top-to-bottom order. It has the same measured clearance below the subtitle as Figure 5. Helvetica is retained. Connecting lines do not represent matched within-person changes. Panel A right compares Stages 1–3 only for all 175 participants, 84 one-month completers and 33 eligible both-follow-up completers. The long-term extension is exploratory and not preregistered.

Confidence uses the existing overall task0 measure and between-participant t intervals. Panels B/C retain their original data, tests and geometry. Their displayed P values are taken from the deposited frozen aggregate; full-sample values are verified by value against the regenerated H2 workbook. Completer-only values are checked against the six original mixed-model contrasts regenerated by `reproduce_completer_tests.R`. No inferential model is refitted in this notebook.

Run from `data-code/Figures/` after `reproduce_completer_tests.R` regenerates the six completer-only contrasts and the public long-term pipeline creates its READY binding in `../Study_2_LongTerm_Results/records/`. `FIGURE6_REPO_ROOT` can select a repository root and `FIGURE6_READY_RUN` selects another verified public run. `FIGURE6_OUTPUT_DIR` and `FIGURE6_DATA_OUTPUT_DIR` redirect outputs. Only deposited data and repository code are required.

```{r figure6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

theme_figure6 <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_family = FONT_FAMILY, base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(TICK_LENGTH_PT, "pt"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = FONT_SIZE_PT, margin = margin(t = 6, b = 1)),

      plot.tag = element_text(size = TAG_SIZE_PT, face = "bold"),
      plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.97),
      legend.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(6, "pt"),

      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}
summarise_mean_ci <- function(data, value, group_vars) {
  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(.data[[value]], na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(.data[[value]], na.rm = TRUE),
              n = sum(!is.na(.data[[value]])), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n), ci95 = qt(0.975, df = pmax(n - 1, 1)) * se)
}

make_attrition_summary <- function(data, sample_label) {
  cl <- data %>%
    select(ID, `Stage 1` = stage1_task0_confidence, `Stage 2` = stage2_task0_confidence, `Stage 3` = stage3_task0_confidence) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(`Stage 1`, `Stage 2`, `Stage 3`), names_to = "Phase_short", values_to = "Confidence") %>%
    mutate(Phase_short = factor(Phase_short, levels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")), Sample = sample_label)
  summarise_mean_ci(cl, value = "Confidence", group_vars = c("Sample", "Phase_short"))
}

# ---- Panels B and C: Stage 2 versus Stage 3 ratings (unchanged) --------------------------------------------------
make_rating_bundle <- function(stage2_col, stage3_col) {
  all_long <- data_filtered %>% select(ID, Label, all_of(c(stage2_col, stage3_col)))
  names(all_long) <- c("ID", "Label", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")
  all_long <- all_long %>% pivot_longer(cols = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3"), names_to = "Phase", values_to = "Rating") %>% drop_na(Rating) %>%
    mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS), Phase = factor(Phase, levels = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3")))
  all_summary <- summarise_mean_ci(all_long, value = "Rating", group_vars = c("Label", "Phase"))
  completer_long <- data_filtered %>% filter(followup_complete) %>% select(ID, Label, all_of(c(stage2_col, stage3_col)))
  names(completer_long) <- c("ID", "Label", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")
  completer_long <- completer_long %>% pivot_longer(cols = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3"), names_to = "Phase", values_to = "Rating") %>% drop_na(Rating) %>%
    mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS), Phase = factor(Phase, levels = c("Stage 2", "Stage 3")))
  completer_summary <- summarise_mean_ci(completer_long, value = "Rating", group_vars = c("Label", "Phase"))
  list(raw = all_long, all = all_summary, completers = completer_summary)
}
willingness <- make_rating_bundle("stage2_task0_willing", "stage3_task0_willing")
usefulness <- make_rating_bundle("stage2_task0_useful", "stage3_task0_useful")
make_rating_plot <- function(bundle, panel_tag, panel_title, y_title = NULL) {
  ggplot(bundle$raw, aes(x = Phase, y = Rating)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = ID), colour = "grey82", alpha = 0.65, linewidth = LINE_SIZE) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = 3, yend = 3, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey55", linewidth = LINE_SIZE) +
    geom_linerange(data = bundle$all, aes(x = Phase, ymin = mean - ci95, ymax = mean + ci95, colour = Label), linewidth = ERROR_LINE_SIZE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_line(data = bundle$all, aes(x = Phase, y = mean, group = Label, colour = Label), linewidth = DATA_LINE_SIZE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = bundle$all, aes(x = Phase, y = mean, shape = Label, fill = Label, colour = Label), size = POINT_SIZE, stroke = POINT_STROKE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_linerange(data = bundle$completers, aes(x = Phase, ymin = mean - ci95, ymax = mean + ci95, colour = Label), linewidth = ERROR_LINE_SIZE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_line(data = bundle$completers, aes(x = Phase, y = mean, group = Label, colour = Label), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = DATA_LINE_SIZE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = bundle$completers, aes(x = Phase, y = mean, shape = Label, colour = Label), fill = "white", size = POINT_SIZE, stroke = POINT_STROKE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~Label, nrow = 1, labeller = as_labeller(GROUP_LABELS)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, breaks = GROUP_LEVELS) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS, breaks = GROUP_LEVELS) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = GROUP_SHAPES, breaks = GROUP_LEVELS) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Stage 2" = "2", "Stage 3" = "3"), expand = expansion(add = 0.75)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = RATING_LIMITS, breaks = RATING_BREAKS, expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
    coord_capped_cart(bottom = "both", left = "both", gap = 0.01) +
    labs(tag = panel_tag, title = panel_title, x = "Stage", y = y_title) +
    theme_figure6() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", panel.spacing = grid::unit(4, "pt"), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 2)),
          plot.tag.position = c(0.01, 0.97), plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 1, 4))
}

full_p <- function(measure) {
  r <- read_excel(file.path(repo_root, "Study_2_Main_Results/results/H2/H2_Within_Task_Attitude_Perceptions.xlsx"),
                  sheet = paste0(measure, "_Posthoc_Stage_Label")) %>%
    filter(.data$contrast == "stage3 - stage2", .data$Label %in% GROUP_LEVELS) %>%
    mutate(Label = factor(.data$Label, levels = GROUP_LEVELS)) %>% arrange(.data$Label)
  stopifnot(nrow(r) == 3)
  vapply(r$p.value, format_p, "")
}
all_w <- full_p("willing"); all_u <- full_p("useful")
get_displayed <- function(panel_name, sample_name) {
  x <- p_values[p_values$panel == panel_name & p_values$sample == sample_name, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(x) == 3L, setequal(x$label, GROUP_LEVELS))
  x$displayed[match(GROUP_LEVELS, x$label)]
}
willing_all <- get_displayed("B willingness", "All")
willing_comp <- get_displayed("B willingness", "Completers")
useful_all <- get_displayed("C usefulness", "All")
useful_comp <- get_displayed("C usefulness", "Completers")
stopifnot(identical(willing_all, all_w), identical(useful_all, all_u))
# Reproduce the original published completer models upstream; this notebook only verifies aggregates.
completer_file <- file.path(repo_root, "Figures/data/figure6_completer_tests.csv")
if (!file.exists(completer_file)) stop("Run Figures/reproduce_completer_tests.R before rendering Figure 6.")
completer_tests <- read.csv(completer_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(completer_tests) == 6L,
          all(c("panel", "sample", "label", "contrast", "p.value", "n_initial_sample", "n_followup_completers") %in% names(completer_tests)),
          !anyDuplicated(completer_tests[c("panel", "sample", "label")]),
          setequal(completer_tests$panel, c("B willingness", "C usefulness")),
          all(completer_tests$sample == "Completers"), all(completer_tests$contrast == "stage3 - stage2"),
          all(completer_tests$n_initial_sample == 175L), all(completer_tests$n_followup_completers == 84L),
          all(is.finite(completer_tests$p.value)), all(completer_tests$p.value >= 0 & completer_tests$p.value <= 1))
computed_completer_display <- function(panel_name) {
  x <- completer_tests[completer_tests$panel == panel_name, ]
  stopifnot(nrow(x) == 3L, setequal(x$label, GROUP_LEVELS))
  vapply(x$p.value[match(GROUP_LEVELS, x$label)], format_p, "")
}
# Frozen labels retain three decimals, so compare their exact displayed strings.
stopifnot(identical(willing_comp, computed_completer_display("B willingness")),
          identical(useful_comp, computed_completer_display("C usefulness")))
hit <- list(computed_completers_verified = TRUE)
make_p_table <- function(values_all, values_completers) {
  p_data <- data.frame(AI = values_all[1:1], AI_Human = values_all[2:2], Human = values_all[3:3], check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  p_data[2, 1:3] <- values_completers
  p_theme <- ttheme_minimal(base_family = FONT_FAMILY, base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
                            core = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0.5, x = 0.5, parse = TRUE), bg_params = list(fill = "white", col = NA),
                                        padding = grid::unit(c(0.75, 1.5), "mm")))
  tbl <- tableGrob(p_data, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, theme = p_theme)
  tbl$widths <- grid::unit.c(grid::unit(1, "null"), grid::unit(1, "null"), grid::unit(1, "null"))
  tbl
}
table_c <- make_p_table(willing_all, willing_comp)
table_d <- make_p_table(useful_all, useful_comp)
table_c_plot <- ggdraw() + draw_grob(table_c, x = 0, y = 0.02, width = 1, height = 0.72) +
  draw_line(x = c(0.092, 0.908), y = c(0.90, 0.90), colour = "grey55", size = LINE_SIZE) +
  draw_label("All", x = -0.13, y = 0.56, hjust = 0, fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
  draw_label("Completers", x = -0.13, y = 0.20, hjust = 0, fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT)
table_d_plot <- ggdraw() + draw_grob(table_d, x = 0, y = 0.02, width = 1, height = 0.72) +
  draw_line(x = c(0.092, 0.908), y = c(0.90, 0.90), colour = "grey55", size = LINE_SIZE)

# ---- Combine and export (original geometry) ----------------------------------------------------------------------
top_row <- (panel_a | plot_spacer() | panel_b) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, ATTRITION_PANEL_LEFT_SPACER, ATTRITION_PANEL_RATIO))
lower_row <- fig23 + fig24 + table_c_plot + table_d_plot + plot_layout(design = "\nAB\nCD\n", widths = c(1, 1), heights = c(1, 0.24))
top_canvas <- ggdraw() + draw_plot(top_row, x = TOP_ROW_X_SHIFT, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1)
lower_canvas <- ggdraw() + draw_plot(lower_row, x = LOWER_ROW_X_SHIFT, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1)
combined_rows <- plot_grid(top_canvas, lower_canvas, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.92, 1.08))
combined_figure <- ggdraw() + draw_plot(combined_rows, x = FIGURE_X_SHIFT, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1)
base <- file.path(fig_out, "Figure_Study2_2")
ggsave(paste0(base, ".pdf"), combined_figure, width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN, height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN, device = function(filename, width, height, ...) {
         if (!capabilities("aqua")) stop("Native macOS Quartz is required for this typography-verified PDF export.")
         grDevices::quartz(type = "pdf", file = filename, width = width, height = height,
                          family = FONT_FAMILY, bg = "white")
       }, bg = "white")
ggsave(paste0(base, ".png"), combined_figure, width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN, height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(paste0(base, ".svg"), combined_figure, width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN, height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN, bg = "white")

          file.path(data_out, "fig6_original_label_summaries.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

          file.path(data_out, "fig6_original_attrition_summaries.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(keep(p33_by_label, c("Label", "Phase_short", "n", "mean", "sd", "se", "ci95")), file.path(data_out, "fig6_primary33_by_label.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(keep(p33_matched, c("Phase_short", "n", "mean", "sd", "se", "ci95")), file.path(data_out, "fig6_primary33_matched.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

                     label = rep(GROUP_LEVELS, 4), displayed = c(willing_all, willing_comp, useful_all, useful_comp),
                     source = rep(rep(c("generated H2 workbook (equals frozen export)", "original completer models (display equals frozen export)"), each = 3), 2)),
          file.path(data_out, "fig6_panel_bc_p_values.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  figure = "Figure 6 no_tools",
  check = c("original Panel A n (175 x3 stages, 84 one month)", "original attrition series n (175, 84)", "added 14-month endpoint n by label",
            "eligible both-follow-up sample n", "displayed B/C P values agree with regenerated original full-sample and completer tests"),
```
